images.author: Kjartan Østbye
images.why: Documentary photograph of Tinnsjøen showing its long mountain corridor and receding ridges. Strong geographical fit, although overcast rather than brightly coloured; resolution unverified.

images.author: Iain Robert Reid
images.why: Sunny Adams Lake shoreline with clear blue water, forested slopes and a yellow canoe providing colour. No person dominates; campsite equipment appears in the foreground. Resolution unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Broad blue-water view framed by vegetation, with wooded mountain slopes and no dominant buildings or people. Lower-resolution fallback: the linked rendition is limited to 1600px.

images.author: Taylor Beach
images.why: Best landscape match: explicitly captioned Lake Chelan, with an elevated view of water and surrounding mountains. Direct link requests a 3000px-wide rendition.

images.author: Jesse Collins
images.why: Documented long exposure of Lake Chelan at night, offering blue tones, stars and mountain silhouettes. Shoreline lights provide an alternative mood; link requests 3000px width.

images.author: September 5th
images.why: Warm sunset over Lake Chelan with a dock as a foreground element; useful colour-focused alternative to the elevated mountain view. Link requests 3000px width.
